definitions.explanation: Rigidly adhering to rules, deadlines, or regulations without exception. Implies zero tolerance for deviation.

examples.japanese: {期限|きげん}を{厳守|げんしゅ}してください。
{時間|じかん}{厳守|げんしゅ}でお{願|ねが}いします。
{安全|あんぜん}ルールの{厳守|げんしゅ}が{事故|じこ}{防止|ぼうし}につながる。
examples.english: Strict observance of safety rules helps prevent accidents.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{時間|じかん}{厳守|げんしゅ} (strict punctuality)
・{期限|きげん}{厳守|げんしゅ} (strict deadline observance)
・ルールを{厳守|げんしゅ}する (strictly observe rules)
・{厳守|げんしゅ}{事項|じこう} (items to be strictly followed)

Frequently seen in workplace notices, official documents, and announcements. The four-character compound {時間|じかん}{厳守|げんしゅ} is one of the most common collocations.
